report_parsed.summary: Over the last 5 minutes of the authorized window (2026-09-28T13:06:27Z–13:11:27Z, policy-window-1), checkout shows failures in the sampled traces: every sampled oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span carries otel.status_code=ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and the linked payment oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans carry otel.status_code=ERROR with the application-level message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'. Affected trace ids: 1cd2addeae73f21af3f55ddbf0f68ccf, 40cb2b714e0c3a8a84c493c95871a97f, c4142662533cf8eeca42b34454b40d08, 60ad1724f3d1adfac6b1cbad241ca699, 4c12c222407bc64f5ea9a73fcf9af16f. The other dependency calls visible in the same traces (cart GetCart, currency Convert, shipping GetQuote, product-catalog GetProduct) all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0; no email span was present in the sample and email span metrics show zero increase for this window. Latency cannot be judged as elevated because no comparable baseline was queried or supplied; only absolute observed values (e.g. checkout PlaceOrder server spans 127–348 ms, payment Charge client spans 12–137 ms) are reportable. Metric evidence is inconsistent with the traces: checkout span series were returned only under status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET and the increase for checkout PlaceOrder was 0, while a product-catalog GetProduct p95 of ~3975 ms conflicts with sub-millisecond product-catalog spans in the sample. These unresolved metric/telemetry-coverage questions, plus a sampled (5 of 20 traces, 8 spans omitted) view, keep the conclusion partial.

claims.text: All five sampled checkout PlaceOrder spans in the window carry error status (status_tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13), on trace ids 1cd2addeae73f21af3f55ddbf0f68ccf, 40cb2b714e0c3a8a84c493c95871a97f, c4142662533cf8eeca42b34454b40d08, 60ad1724f3d1adfac6b1cbad241ca699 and 4c12c222407bc64f5ea9a73fcf9af16f (service checkout, version 2.0.2).

The checkout PlaceOrder error description names the payment charge step: 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (otel.status_description and exception.message on those spans).

payment service spans named grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carry error status (otel.status_code=ERROR) with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and a stack trace in /usr/src/app/charge.js, inside traces 1cd2addeae73f21af3f55ddbf0f68ccf, 40cb2b714e0c3a8a84c493c95871a97f, 60ad1724f3d1adfac6b1cbad241ca699 and 4c12c222407bc64f5ea9a73fcf9af16f.

The checkout-side client spans for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge are also error status (otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2) in all five sampled checkout traces, and the enclosing frontend (POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout'), frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress) and load-generator spans in those traces show error=true with http.status_code 500.

Within the same sampled traces, checkout's calls to oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct are recorded with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (success) and no error status, and the corresponding cart, currency, shipping and product-catalog server spans also show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / http.status_code 200.

No email span appears in the sampled checkout trace graph, and the span-call metric shows zero increase in the window for all three email span names (POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email, sinatra.render_template).

Observed span durations in the sampled window: checkout PlaceOrder server spans 123,239–348,279 us; payment Charge client spans (checkout side) 37,286–137,574 us; shipping GetQuote 25,476–95,457 us; currency Convert 1,435–38,044 us; product-catalog GetProduct 339–12,573 us; cart GetCart 1,317–67,385 us. These are absolute values for a single window with no baseline supplied.

The span-call metric aggregation returned checkout series only under status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET (including span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with increase 0), and the only error-status (STATUS_CODE_ERROR) series returned for any service were payment GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect plus frontend GET, frontend-proxy ingress, load-generator GET and recommendation EventStream.

Server-duration histogram quantiles for the window: product-catalog GetProduct p95 ≈ 3975 ms (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket) and ListProducts p95 ≈ 46.25 ms; checkout PlaceOrder returned NaN and no histogram series were returned for payment, cart, currency, shipping or email.

app_payment_transactions_total returned a single payment series with increase 0 over the window (no status dimension returned), i.e. the counter shows no increment while five failed payment charges are visible in the traces.

The checkout failures in this window are most plausibly a downstream payment behaviour: payment's Charge handler rejects the request ('Invalid token'), checkout surfaces it as gRPC code 13 on PlaceOrder, and frontend returns HTTP 500 to the load generator. The visible parent references show checkout PlaceOrder as parent of the checkout->payment Charge client span and payment Charge as child of it, consistent with this ordering, but the sample is partial so this remains a hypothesis rather than a proven causal chain.

The product-catalog GetProduct p95 of ≈3975 ms may indicate server-side latency in product-catalog, but it cannot be called elevated without a baseline, and it is not corroborated by the sub-millisecond product-catalog GetProduct spans in the sampled traces.

The checkout failures are not explained by the cart, currency, shipping or product-catalog dependencies returning errors: every such checkout client span in the sampled window is recorded with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and no error status.

The product-catalog server-duration p95 of ≈3975 ms (metric) is contradicted in the same window by product-catalog GetProduct server spans of 339–979 us in the sampled traces, so the metric alone does not establish elevated product-catalog latency.

Span-call metrics do not corroborate the trace-visible checkout/payment error status: checkout spans were returned only under status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET with increase 0 for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, and app_payment_transactions_total shows increase 0 despite five failed charges in the traces.

gaps: No baseline window was queried or supplied, so 'elevated' latency cannot be assessed; only absolute values for 2026-09-28T13:06:27Z–13:11:27Z are known.

The traces view is a biased sample: 5 of 20 requested checkout traces were returned, 159 backend spans with 151 shown and 8 omitted, and the same trace set was returned for the payment query; omitted spans and any non-sampled traces are unknown.

The explicit metric query for checkout errors with status_code="ERROR" returned status no_data (evidence 56549a44-950b-4155-8778-ab0a11f267fb-t2:d548c3b6-be8a-4a78-84bb-17aead16e738), so whether the error-status label exists for checkout is unresolved; no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for cart, currency, shipping or product-catalog dependency calls either.

rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count for service_name="payment" returned no_data (evidence 38e4de90-4df1-4f58-8490-a2527428736d-t3:fea9583b-bfa4-440b-b166-f1df428d99bd), so payment-side client latency is unknown, and no payment/cart/currency/shipping/email rpc_server_duration histogram series were returned at all.
email behaviour is unknown for this window: no email span was sampled and its span metrics show only zero increase, which does not prove email calls were attempted and failed or succeeded.
No error or log evidence beyond the sampled span error_details was collected, so the cause and the population of clients/tokens affected by the payment 'Invalid token' rejection are unknown.
next_steps: Have a human compare checkout PlaceOrder / payment Charge error rates and latencies against an earlier baseline window to judge elevation and onset.
Have a human inspect payment's charge handler and token/loyalty-level configuration ('Invalid token', app.loyalty.level=gold) and the load-generator token source.
Have a human verify whether the span-metric pipeline labels checkout/payment error statuses as expected, since span status_code labels conflict with trace error tags in this window.
Have a human confirm email and payment-side latency metrics exist and are exported before drawing any conclusion about those dependencies.
